hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: A Uniswap V4 hook for prediction market pools implementing the VALS (Volatile-Adjusted Liquidity Spread) fee formula. Each swap requires a backend-signed sigma (toxic velocity) parameter; fees are calculated as e^[λ*(Δx/L)*σ]−1 and routed to a YieldDistributor rather than to LPs. Swaps and liquidity additions are blocked when the prediction market is resolved or disputed.
